This should be flagged as a moderate artifact (severity 3). The animal_pose_auditor shows low confidence in some keypoints (Right_Ear, Right_Shoulder, Left_Elbow), but the artifact_risk_level is LOW, so no major structural defects are indicated. Overall, the Router underestimated the boundary artifact severity and missed the topological fragmentation indicated by the mask confidence score.
